name: Crimson Curse
blurb: Innate:  Briar has no  base health regeneration but she gains increased healing from other sources based on her missing health.

effects.description: Innate: Briar's basic attacks on-hit and abilities inflict a bleed against enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, stacking up to 5 times and dealing 25% damage for stacks beyond the first. The bleed deals[ 10 - 54.71 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) total physical damage and heals Briar for 2.5 - 13.68 (based on level) (+ 12.5% bonus AD) over the duration, increased by 2.5 - 13.68 (based on level) (+ 12.5% bonus AD) and 0.63 - 3.42 (based on level) (+ 3.125% bonus AD) for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of 20 - 109.41 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) total physical damage and 5 - 27.35 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) over the duration. ][ 1 - 5.47 (based on level) (+ 5% bonus AD) physical damage and heals Briar for 0.25 - 1.37 (based on level) (+ 1.25% bonus AD) every 0.5 seconds, increased by 0.25 - 1.37 (based on level) (+ 1.25% bonus AD) and 0.06 - 0.34 (based on level) (+ 0.3125% bonus AD) for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of 2 - 10.94 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) physical damage and 0.5 - 2.74 (based on level) (+ 2.5% bonus AD) per tick. ]If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 125% of the remaining bleed damage.
Briar has no base health regeneration, but she increases healing from all sources by 0% - 40% (based on missing health) (+ 0% - 2.5% (based on missing health) per 100 bonus health).

notes:
The bleed always heals Briar for 25% of the pre-mitigation damage dealt.
Because of this, Briar will not heal on  invulnerable targets.
 Blood Frenzy's area of effect damage around the target does not apply bleed stacks.
